Needs changes before merge.

The import uses the existing model command and MCP tool. Kernel refusals retain their diagnostic text. The dependency decision lists the imported items and the rebuild effects.

Local source review:
- The trial merge with upstream/main a49322b9c succeeded in `.claude/worktrees/review-2150`.
- Not built: needs a maintainer look at `crates/app/Cargo.toml:37` and `Cargo.lock` first. This PR adds the native camcraft-app -> camcraft-kernel dependency. The review rules require source review without a build for a dependency change.
- Build, tests and clippy: not run. No GitHub runner was used.
- Safety tier: this PR changes geometry import. No goldens moved.
- Mutations: not run under the dependency restriction. The body reports one mutation, removal of `sc` from `MODEL_EXTENSIONS`. This review does not verify that result. Two independent mutation checks remain required for the safety review after the dependency decision.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/ui/src/state.rs:4515` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/file_drop.rs:42`: add before/after screenshots to the PR body. The picker filter and the drop refusal text change. The body has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body.
2. `crates/app/src/geometry/import/solidcraft.rs:22`: move the domain-only parser and mesh conversion to the geometry or kernel crate. Current upstream AGENTS.md, "app holds the document, nothing else", requires this placement. This module reads bytes and geometry values. It does not read or write the ECS world, project file, a command, MCP or the CLI. Keep the app dispatch and command wiring in app. The dependency decision records the new edge, but does not exempt this module from the placement rule.

Notes:
- The watchdog requests cancellation after 300 seconds. It does not guarantee completion within 300 seconds. The kernel documents that its planner has no cancellation hook. Please describe this as cooperative cancellation in the body.
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs` grows beyond the approximate 400-line limit. This is a nonblocking size note.
- This review uses current upstream/main AGENTS.md. No process file or snapshot PNG changes in this PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Added before/after screenshots for the native picker and drop refusal to the PR body. The images are only on `pr-screenshots` at `994d7844862ea66d4f2a4fea134a370a75566fb3`. All four links return the captured PNGs. Removing one link made the evidence check fail. Restoring it made the check pass.
2. Moved the domain parser and mesh conversion to `camcraft_geometry::solidcraft`. App keeps dispatch, command wiring, and error mapping. The pin is `domain_parser_preserves_the_kernel_refusal_reason`. Removing the geometry API failed compilation. Erasing the kernel reason failed the assertion. Both passed after restoration.
3. Corrected the cancellation description in the body and decision file. The watchdog requests cooperative cancellation after 300 seconds. It does not guarantee completion within that time.

The drop pin `a_solidcraft_design_drop_queues_the_import` also passed a mutation check. Removing `sc` made it fail. Restoring `sc` made it pass.

Gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 10 steps after its batch fallback. All-target clippy with `-D warnings` passed for geometry, app, UI, and kernel.

New head: `13d33b478a7539271fa2ce0a124009f1759c9bd9`.

Please re-review this head. The PR remains draft.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 13d33b478a7539271fa2ce0a124009f1759c9bd9 -->
Not built - needs a maintainer look. Source review has no blockers.

The two earlier requested changes are complete:
- The parser and mesh conversion now live in `crates/geometry/src/solidcraft.rs`. App keeps dispatch and error mapping. The geometry test imports the domain API.
- The body has before/after images for the picker and drop refusal. All four URLs return PNG files. I inspected them. The picker now shows the `.sc` file. The refusal now lists `.sc`.

The body and decision file now describe cooperative cancellation. They do not promise completion within 300 seconds.

Local results:
- Trial merge with upstream/main `dab6498aed0ab078a97f0892c417d161135219fa` succeeded without conflicts in `.claude/worktrees/review-2150`.
- `git diff --check upstream/main...review-2150` passed.
- Not built: needs a maintainer look at `crates/geometry/Cargo.toml:11-15` and `Cargo.lock` first. The PR adds tracing and the native geometry-to-kernel dependency. The review rules require source review without a build for a dependency change.
- Build, tests and clippy: not run. No GitHub runner was used. The author's reported gate is not an independent test result.
- Safety tier: this PR changes geometry import. No PR goldens moved. The conversion uses checked vertex lookup. App retains its finiteness gate. The kernel mesher checks tolerance, watertightness and positive volume.
- Mutations: not run under the dependency restriction. Removing the geometry API, erasing the kernel diagnostic, and removing `sc` from the extension list are author-reported checks only. At least two independent red/green mutation checks remain required after the dependency decision. This is not a completed safety test review.

Requested code changes: none.

Notes:
- The dependency decision lists the imported items, the caller constraint and the rebuild effects.
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs:4515` grows an existing file beyond the approximate 400-line limit. This remains a nonblocking size note.
- This review uses current upstream/main AGENTS.md. The PR changes no process file or snapshot PNG.
- The PR is mergeable. The correct state is `needs-maintainer`, pending the dependency decision and independent safety tests.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The latest review requests no code changes.

I merged upstream main locally. The only conflict was the geometry module list. The resolution keeps both exports.

Mutation checks:
- Remove `solidcraft`: compilation fails. Restore it: `domain_parser_preserves_the_kernel_refusal_reason` passes.
- Remove `sketch_chains`: compilation fails. Restore it: `self_crossing_loop_is_refused_by_name` passes.

The quick gate used its batch fallback. Nine of ten steps passed. All-target clippy passed for geometry, kernel, app, and UI.

The app test `first_4axis_part::the_committed_project_posts_the_committed_program` fails at line 60. The refusal says: `Flat A-90: inputs moved since generation - regenerate before posting`. The exact test retry gives the same result. The test, fixture, loader, machine checks, and operation stamp match upstream main.

I stopped before the push, as the conflict skill requires for this failure. The local merge is `392a5729a7220f98e733a87c1cbe826a524c2cb2` on branch `fix-2150`. The remote head remains `13d33b478a7539271fa2ce0a124009f1759c9bd9`. The PR is now draft. No labels changed.

Please review this gate failure before a new review of the merge. The dependency decision and independent safety review remain pending.

Maintainer decision of 2026-11-16 (question dialog): the new dependency edge of this PR is accepted. The next steps are:

- The author merges `main` into the branch and removes the conflict.
- A safety-floor review with a build follows on the new head.
- The PR merges only when that review is clean.

The latest source review requested no code changes. The maintainer accepted the dependency and requested a merge of main before the safety review.

Merged upstream/main into the branch. The only conflict was the geometry module list. The resolution keeps Solidcraft and all exports from main.

Pins and mutation checks:
- Removing `solidcraft` causes an unresolved-import failure. Restoring it makes `domain_parser_preserves_the_kernel_refusal_reason` pass.
- Removing `sketch_chains` causes an unresolved-import failure. Restoring it makes `self_crossing_loop_is_refused_by_name` pass. Main's self-crossing refusal remains intact.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed its batch fallback: 788 steps, zero failures. The previously failing `first_4axis_part` suite passed. All-target clippy with `-D warnings` passed for geometry, kernel, app, and UI.

New head: `5725363a24eae83d34aeeee9bc05ef7db9adf0df`.

Please re-review this head with the requested independent safety review and build. The PR remains draft. No labels changed.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 5725363a24eae83d34aeeee9bc05ef7db9adf0df -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocker specific to this PR was found.

The earlier requested changes are complete:
- The parser and mesh conversion are in `crates/geometry/src/solidcraft.rs`. App keeps dispatch, error mapping, and command wiring.
- The body has before/after screenshots for the picker and drop refusal. All four links return PNG files. I inspected each image.
- The body and decision file describe cooperative cancellation. They do not promise completion within 300 seconds.
- NeoTech accepted the dependency in the comment of 2026-11-16. The author merged main. The geometry module resolution keeps both sets of exports.

Local results:
- The trial merge with upstream/main `fac6c8e8d22cb39bb0a4c18644b4ec1c4dbd2db6` succeeded without conflicts.
- All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2150`. No GitHub runner was used.
- Geometry `solidcraft`: 1 passed.
- App `import_solidcraft`: 3 passed, 2 ignored. The ignored tests require the release lane and were not run.
- App `import_bytes`: 2 passed.
- App `import_outward`: 4 passed.
- App `first_4axis_part`: 4 passed. The failure named in the earlier comment did not recur.
- UI library, from `crates/ui`: 984 passed, 1 failed, 6 ignored. See the baseline failure below.
- All-target clippy with `-D warnings`: passed for geometry, kernel, app, and UI.
- The diff check passed. The worktree has no remaining source changes from the mutation checks.
- The first app build ended with exit code 143. The retry built successfully and passed its tests.

Baseline failure, not introduced by this PR:
`egui_app::rest_pocket_tests::rest_group_warns_and_refuses_incompatible_strategy_and_predrilled_on_apply` fails at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/rest_pocket_tests.rs:280`:

```text
Zigzag draft refusal
```

I checked out unchanged upstream/main `fac6c8e8d22cb39bb0a4c18644b4ec1c4dbd2db6` in the same worktree. The exact test failed there with the same message and line. I then restored the trial merge. The full UI suite is not green.

Safety review:
- This PR changes geometry import. It uses the checked kernel reader and machining mesh at the 0.005 mm chord cap.
- Vertex lookup is checked. App retains its finiteness check. The kernel mesher refuses incomplete, out-of-tolerance, or invalid-volume meshes.
- No golden files moved. No snapshot PNG or process file changed.
- I independently ran two mutation checks. Each failed with the mutation and passed after restoration:
  1. Replace the kernel refusal reason with generic text. `domain_parser_preserves_the_kernel_refusal_reason` failed, then passed.
  2. Remove `sc` from `MODEL_EXTENSIONS`. `a_solidcraft_design_drop_queues_the_import` failed, then passed.

Requested changes: none.

Notes:
- The two release-only app tests, the browser build, Windows, and macOS were not exercised.
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs:4672` grows an existing file beyond the approximate 400-line limit. This remains a nonblocking size note.
- This review uses current upstream/main AGENTS.md. The PR is mergeable. The dependency decision is complete, so the state label is `merge-ready`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
